text:
Type: deco
Name: Stone & Beam Modern Round Seagrass Storage Basket Set - Pack of 3 (Renewed)
You'll wonder how you ever managed without these versatile baskets. They hold blankets, throws and magazines -- even the assorted items you hid quickly before your mother-in-law arrived. When not in use, they fit inside one another for easy storage. Large: 14.6" W x 15.7" D x 13" H; Medium: 12.2" W x 13.8" D x 11.8" H; Small: 10.2" W x 11.8" D x 11" H Gold metal accents on the sides add decorative elements to your room along with storage space Seagrass and metal mesh; gold metal accents; convenient openings to use as side handles When not in use, they stack inside one another to save space
